conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Collections Department, Officer Harris speaking. How may I assist you today?
Uh, hi, I got a voicemail saying I might be eligible for some sort of tax refund? Is that right?

Yes, our records indicate an unclaimed federal tax refund owed to you for the 2023 fiscal year. To proceed, I must verify your identity. May I have your full name and current address as they appear on your last tax return?
Sure, it's Denise Carter, 142 Oakridge Drive, Apt 7, Springfield.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. Could you also confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your Social Security Number for security purposes?
It's 05/22/1987, and the last four are 5492.

Perfect. Please hold while I access your IRS file... Yes, you are owed $1,724.13. However, due to recent adjustments to IRS policies, a one-time verification fee of $197 is required to release the funds.
A fee? I thought refunds just come automatically. I really need the money, but I wasn't expecting this.

This is a standard IRS clearance procedure established for all refund disbursements over $1,000. If you do not submit the fee by today, your refund will be forfeited and your account flagged for review. Do you understand the urgency?
I guess so. I just... I'm at work and I have to pick up my daughter soon. How do I pay this fee?

For your convenience, the IRS now accepts clearance payments via electronic gift cards, specifically, Target or Apple gift cards. This ensures immediate processing. Please let me know which retailer is nearest to you.
There's a Target about ten minutes away, I think.

Excellent. Please proceed to the Target store and purchase four gift cards of $50 each. Once you have them, do not leave the premises, call me immediately with the codes so I can process your refund release.
Wait, you want the codes from the cards? That seems weird for the IRS.
Ma'am, this is an official IRS process. If you fail to comply, not only will your refund be canceled, but you may also be subject to a hold on next year's tax filings and additional penalties.
Okay, I just don't want to get in trouble. I guess I can go now, but can you stay on the line?

I will remain on the line to ensure compliance and provide guidance. Do not discuss this transaction with store employees, as this is a confidential IRS matter. Notify me once you have purchased the cards.
Alright, I'm heading there now.
Thank you. Remember, time is of the essence. If the clearance fee is not processed within the next 30 minutes, your file will be escalated for enforcement action.
I'm in the parking lot now, just getting my kid out of the car seat. I'll call back in a few minutes.
Very good. Once you have the cards and receipts, read the codes to me clearly. This will allow me to initiate the refund transfer to your bank account.
Okay, I got four $50 Target cards. Do you need the numbers from the back?
Correct. Please read each card's code and the activation number, if available. We require these to authenticate your payment.
Alright, first card: 1359 8726 4482, PIN 634. Second card: 2486 9107 3351, PIN 220. Third card: 6721 5893 0147, PIN 811. The last is 4792 3360 1228, PIN 503.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. Please hold while I verify your payment. Do not disconnect the call.
Okay. How soon will I get my refund?

Assuming all information is correct, your refund will be processed within 24 hours. However, there appears to be an additional discrepancy regarding your 2021 filing. For full release, an additional $75 clearance is required.
I already gave you almost $200! I seriously can't keep leaving work.

If you do not settle the outstanding clearance immediately, your account will be placed on administrative hold and may be subject to tax garnishments. I recommend resolving this now to avoid further complications. Are you able to purchase a $75 Apple gift card at the same location?
I guess so. I don't want any garnishments or holds. I'll go get it now.
